name: last_final_sudoku_hard_benchmark_no_hardskill
description: A benchmark of hard Sudoku problems intended to measure an agent or model's ability to solve high-difficulty constraint-satisfaction puzzles (complete the board to a valid solution). It evaluates reasoning and planning over discrete structured state represented as Sudoku grids, typically by comparing generated solutions to ground-truth boards. Used for testing search, constraint solving, and neural-symbolic approaches.
reputation: Niche dataset primarily used by researchers in constraint-solving and reinforcement-learning for puzzle/benchmarking tasks; limited mainstream adoption.
